title: Reuse constant JavaScript Intl formatters
why: Intl formatter construction resolves locale data and options, so rebuilding an equivalent formatter on every iteration repeats avoidable setup work.
suggestion: Create the formatter once outside the loop and reuse its format or compare method.
limitations: Only direct DateTimeFormat, NumberFormat, and Collator construction with no arguments or literal locale and simple literal options inside recognized braced loops is reported.
Formatter aliases, dynamic locale data, nested option values, wrapper factories, and hot-path frequency are not inferred.
